change: Implemented git ref validation using subprocess.run
impact: Enables programmatic verification of git references against the local repository

change: Added git reference validation and wrapped compute_diff in an exception handler.
impact: Improves robustness by preventing invalid input errors and providing cleaner failure messaging.

change: Integration of brain.yaml configuration to load ignore patterns for analysis.
impact: The analyze_project function now filters files based on user-defined exclusion patterns.

change: Added git repository validation and grouped output display by file.
impact: Prevents execution outside git repos and improves console readability with grouped file headers.

change: Added a suffix check for .egg-info directories in the exclusion logic.
impact: Files and directories within .egg-info folders are now automatically skipped by the function.

change: Implemented a binary file detection check using null byte inspection of the first 1024 bytes.
impact: Files containing null bytes are now correctly identified as binary; others as text.

change: No functional changes were made.
impact: The code logic remains identical to the previous version.

change: Added an ignore_patterns parameter and an explicit skip check for binary files.
impact: Reduces processing time and avoids errors by filtering out binary files from analysis.

change: Added explicit error handling for failed git commands and standardized return types for empty diffs.
impact: Prevents silent failures and ensures consistent data structures for downstream consumers.

change: Added a trailing comma to the subprocess.run arguments list.
impact: Improves code style consistency and simplifies future diffs.

change: Refined the modified functions identification by adding a content equality check.
impact: Reduces false positives by only flagging functions that have actual body changes.

change: Replaced direct path existence check with a call to an external function is_git_repo.
impact: Decouples directory verification logic and relies on an external implementation for repository identification.

change: Added a check for the existence of the .brain/cache directory.
impact: The doctor command now reports a warning if the cache directory is missing.

change: Added an explicit limit on the number of JSON files preserved in the cache directory.
impact: Automatically purges the oldest JSON cache files when the count exceeds the threshold.

change: Converted changed_funcs set to a list and added an explicit check to skip processing if no functions were changed.
impact: Prevents redundant iterations and potential errors when processing files with no actual function changes.

change: Added a call to cleanup_cache after saving new data.
impact: Triggers cache management logic to remove old entries or enforce limits.

change: Added a condition to exclude paths containing components ending in .egg-info.
impact: Files and directories related to Python egg-info metadata will now be automatically skipped.
